title: Eighteenmile Creek 2023 — original trace-metal observations
interpretation: Each sampling activity retains all nine original unfiltered metal results and its separate calcium, magnesium and hardness observations.
Below-limit markers are located at the original quantification limit. Their blank reported-value fields remain blank.
Reported ranges summarize only the quantified original results in the same analyte, unit, fraction and method group.
The calendar identifies actual sampled activities and dates. Different stations have different sampling schedules.
Original result, activity and laboratory comments, collection methods, analytical methods and source row identities travel with every selected result.
